spots.name: Palenzuela
spots.blurb: You've reached Palenzuela, a mural by Alfredo Sosabravo from 1992. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Taiger Forever
spots.blurb: You've reached Taiger Forever, a mural by Arley Valdes. Mural en homenaje a José Manuel Carbajal, conocido como El Taiger. Este es el inicio de los tributos en Cuba al reguetonero.
